IS 1448 : Part 113 : 2026 Petroleum and its Products - Methods of Test - Part 113 Determinations of Total Acidity in Aviation Turbine Fuel
ICS 75.080
ICS 75.080
PCD 01

1 SCOPE
This standard (Part 113) describes the determination of the total acidity in aviation turbine fuel in the range from 0.000 mg KOH/g to 0.100 mg KOH/g.
